purpose: Test whether the existing presence penalty contributes to action/actor substitutions in frozen extraction controls. This is a causal diagnostic, not model promotion.
fixed: all seven frozen originals, speaker labels and expected semantic judgments
identical original payload order and system prompt
WikiClaimsV1 grammar and native source binding
remaining numeric sampler parameters and seed 42
evaluation: Review all generated claims and native bindings against unchanged source action, performer, speech act, status and absence of unsupported time/outcomes. Retain all failed, missing and ambiguous responses. Native binding and test exit status alone are not semantic acceptance.
hypothesis: The presence penalty may discourage faithful action/actor reuse; neither this mechanism nor a quality improvement is established.
causalLimit: One paired run per case cannot establish repeatability or whole-compiler success. The same frozen full-model gates remain required.
networkPolicy: OS-level network denial; cached weights only; isolated synthetic app state
